Long-lived dual-write or compatibility reads after cutover.

constraints: BB-155 must be DELIVERED before migration execution begins.
Migrate only tasks that are unfinished and not explicitly withdrawn at the exact cutover snapshot. DONE tasks are not migrated; their delivered truth is Living Docs.
No dual-write and no long-lived legacy reader after cutover. V2 becomes the sole write/read authority for migrated current work.

Preserve work ids, semantic objective/current plan, direct dependencies, components, lane/phase meaning, and any current readiness/candidate/evaluation authority that is still valid at the cutover snapshot.
Do not invent historical generations. Each migrated Work starts at V2 generation 1 (or one deterministic initial generation) with legacy source SHA recorded as migration provenance.
Existing raw evidence/receipt files may remain as immutable referenced blobs when still required by an unfinished Work; physical storage cleanup is not required for cutover.
Migration must fail before authority switch if any unfinished Work cannot be transformed or if parity/next-action verification differs.
invariants: Exact included/excluded id sets partition the locked snapshot; all unfinished non-withdrawn tasks migrate, ordinary BLOCKED remains included.
Imported Work generation1 preserves semantics/edges/components and only current validated phase-relevant authority; no fake Jev verdict or historical generations.
Every included Work passes semantic/readiness/blocker/immediate-action parity; any mismatch aborts before visibility.
All import rows, receipt, allocator and selector publish in one SQLite transaction under a held external source-write freeze.
After selector commit current Work uses only V2; unsupported clients/legacy writes reject and no fallback or dual-write occurs.
DONE/withdrawn task resources remain absent; DONE dependency truth is externally bound Living delivery evidence.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Use resolved BB-155 Node/SQLite service (Work.generation/resourceVersion; readSnapshot/createWork/apply/readRecord). BB-155 must be DELIVERED before migration execution. Prefer BB-157 DELIVERED capability for operational 155 ->157 ->156, but do not change the canonical direct dependency. Explicit controller capability/schema digest goes in manifest; no unresolved API discovery or legacy adapter substitution.

D2 — Prepare a V2-aware trusted controller/CLI/CI/bootstrap release before switching authority. It uses one service-owned selector and refuses unsupported protocol/schema or unreachable/wrong authority; no cwd/Git fallback. Before cutover only the bounded migration reader can read the pinned legacy snapshot; after cutover it is disabled. Git/source changes alone never select authority. Source and evaluator receipts remain external immutable data, not current-work readers.

D3 — Freeze legacy publication under a maintenance barrier: trusted operator obtains repository-main write lock plus server freeze receipt, drains all claimed/running/provider operations, then captures exact main SHA and graph/component/Living/objective/plan/receipt blob closure. Enforce old-client/controller deny at the publication boundary. If the lock/drain cannot be proven, fail before import; do not pretend Git and SQLite form one transaction. Crash leaves legacy read authority intact with writes paused until explicit abort/recovery.

D4 — Manifest exact predicate: include every task status!=DONE except status==BLOCKED and title starts a valid [WITHDRAWN ...] marker. Never exclude all BLOCKED tasks. Record every included/excluded id and reason and reject malformed ambiguous withdrawal or dangling/withdrawn dependency. Pin all required regular-file refs and Git object identity; no registration-time count is used as cutover input.

D5 — Deterministic transform creates exactly one generation1 Work per included id; preserve objective and current plan inline bodies/semantic hashes, direct dependency ids/requires, components, lane/phase meaning and relevant valid authority. Legacy provenance references exact snapshot/task/body hashes. DONE dependencies remain id-labelled external LIVING bindings resolved against delivered consolidated refs/receipts; no DONE Work is imported. Existing independent V2 namespace work is preserved and separately hash-bound.

D6 — Trusted legacy validators run read-only against an owned immutable snapshot checkout and exact fetched Git objects. Validate every Worker readiness with assertReady, and candidate evaluation only when phase JUDGMENT/REPAIR/MERGE_PENDING requires it, using materialize/validateEvaluation. Invalid required authority aborts; irrelevant stale candidate artifacts in EXECUTION remain immutable diagnostic refs and are not carried as current Decisions. Do not silently promote or downgrade phase. LegacyImportReceipt binds original independent evaluation bytes/hash/stateHash/cacheKey and new generation1 semantic mapping; it never rewrites Jev answers or invents historical generations.

D7 — Independent phase-aware oracle uses exact status/lane/phase, taskReadiness, derived delivery context and trusted receipts. Unclaimed research -> START_RESEARCH; unclaimed Worker execution -> CLAIM_EXECUTION only readiness/deps valid; MERGE_PENDING -> VERIFY_MERGE; ordinary BLOCKED has no source action. Unknown/unsettled JUDGMENT/REPAIR/current ownership aborts parity. Compare full semantic action class, guards/scopes/receipt hashes, not claim-schedulability booleans.

D8 — Compare ALL manifest items: exact id/semantic hashes/direct edges/components, current readiness/candidate authority role and blockers/action preconditions. Validate DONE Living bindings without copying DONE task resources. Pure V2 nextActions on transformed explicit facts must match legacy immediate action class and dependency set; report any mismatch with exact refs. Unknown phase, missing receipt/object, duplicate id, withdrawal ambiguity and unresolved authority are blockers before commit.

D9 — One ControlStore migration transaction checks expected authority revision, schema/controller capability, maintained repository freeze receipt, unchanged source SHA/manifest hash and destination pre-existing-set hash; inserts ALL Work/Attempt/import receipts and publishes cutover receipt + selector V2 + allocator switch in the SAME SQLite COMMIT. No per-work visible partial batch and no separate publish-then-change-scripts window. Any failure rolls back all rows/selector. Git metadata/route rollout was prepared before this point. Lost success response is recovered by immutable manifest/receipt idempotence, never a second import.

D10 — After the transaction service is sole read/write authority; old protocol, legacy graph mutations and unsupported lifecycle clients reject. Bootstrap/context/claim/evaluation/publication entry points use the configured service and pinned controller, not local graph/currentContextRef/jev.md. Retire legacy current graph/state with non-authoritative deprecation pointers; immutable snapshot/evidence/receipts remain only when unfinished Work needs them. Frozen source lock is released only after verifying every included id and required published controller surfaces; no fallback/dual-write on failure.

D11 — Recommended supervision-aware cutover includes BB-157 capability and immutable Decision/reflection subjects; migration does not fake a reflection for an already failed candidate. If new supervisor semantics cannot preserve a legacy immediate action, parity blocks cutover and the source Work must be properly resolved before a new snapshot. This is a precondition, not a fabricated migration success.

D12 — Tests use owned SQLite/controller/repository lock fixtures and exact snapshot data; they never lock the real repository or switch live authority during research. Record actual cutover deployment/environment credentials as Worker operational preconditions. Preserve independent Jev, negative-case/evidence and exact candidate/merge-tree/Living delivery checks throughout the route change.
implementationSlices: S1 — migrate-legacy.mjs/main-freeze.mjs. Implement buildMigrationManifest(snapshot) from locked Git main SHA and complete regular-file closure. GithubMainFreeze saves protection, enables enforceable main lock, confirms GET protection/main identity and creates service-owned freeze receipt; no unsupported lock means no capture. Drain claims/callbacks. Predicate includes every unfinished status except exact withdrawn BLOCKED marker; record excluded DONE/withdrawn separately. Assert unique/disjoint exhaustive graph-id partition; reject ambiguous marker, withdrawn dependency or missing object. Canonical manifest hashes graph/registry/closure/authority/controller/destination ids and allocation boundary, never a hardcoded count.

S2 — migrate-legacy.mjs/work-resource.mjs/trust adapter. Implement transformLegacyWork for every included id into delivered strict generation1/RV1 Work with inline exact semantics, direct edge ids/requires/components/scopes and provenance. Resolve DONE dependencies into exact Living delivery bindings without DONE rows. Migration-role immutable LegacyImportReceipt maps original valid readiness/current candidate authority without rewriting Jev bytes/cacheKey; source receipt and new Work mapping remain separate. Current status refs point to immutable imported versions/bridge. Preserve MERGE_PENDING and accepted candidate; unused EXECUTION stale candidate refs are diagnostic. Unsettled JUDGMENT/REPAIR/ownership fails rather than manufactures a lease/reflection/Decision.

S3 — migrate-legacy.mjs. Implement assertMigrationParity over EVERY manifest id: independent legacy phase-aware facts versus actual delivered nextActions/buildContext over transformed Work and imported authority/dependency facts. Compare exact semantics, edges/components, readiness and required receipts, action semantic class, guards, blockers and write/read authority. Research unclaimed action is START_RESEARCH, not direct PUBLISH_PLAN. Produce canonical per-work report with checked set hash/mismatch list, require zero mismatches and exact exhaustive id set. Optional delivered BB-157 capability enforces LOOKBACK/reconsideration semantics; unresolved legacy repair must legitimately settle before a fresh snapshot.

S4 — control-store/CLI/transport/legacy entrypoints/workflows. Ship selector-aware pinned release before freeze; service selector starts currentWorkAuthority LEGACY/namespace mode ISOLATED_NEW_WORK. Implement commitMigration single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with current mode/revision, held lock/main/manifest/parity/controller/destination guards; insert full set+bridges+cutover receipt+allocator and flip both selectors in one COMMIT. All failures roll back. Test crash at each insertion/selector boundary, restart and exact lost-response idempotence. Prepared source clients query selector, V2 routes only to service; legacy-current access denies after flip, historical access requires explicit snapshot. Validate all listed bootstrap/context/claim/eval/publication and CI consumers; only then restore saved main protection/release freeze. No dual-write or automatic rollback after commit.

S5 — test/blackboard-v2-migration.test.mjs/routing docs. Actual exported buildMigrationManifest/transformLegacyWork/assertMigrationParity/commitMigration/client functions, literal negative bindings and all phase cases. Tests: ordinary BLOCKED vs withdrawal/DONE; source/hash/receipt/edge/scope preservation; every-id parity; held/unheld/failed native lock; partial import rollback; existing isolated Work unchanged; selector race/protocol deny; fresh-session create/show/next/context from different cwd; postflip legacy writers rejected. Run migration/control/supervision focused checks when capability enabled, repository/docs and independent Worker judgment. No research script locks real main or migrates current work; real cutover additionally requires exact frozen operational evidence. Update existing test/blackboard-*.test.mjs to explicit owned frozen legacy fixtures where they exercise historical validators; current verify/CI exercises V2 service records instead of parsing deprecated graph. No skipped/deleted checks.

snapshotContract.manifest: BLACKBOARD_V2_MIGRATION_MANIFEST_V1 {id,legacySnapshotSha,sourceTree,graphHash,registryHash,controllerDigest,schemaVersion,capabilities,freezeReceiptRef,preExistingV2SetHash,included:[{id,taskHash,objectiveRef/hash,planRef/semanticHash,requiredReceiptRefs/hashes,componentRefs/hashes,dependencyBindings,legacyState,nextActionClass}],excludedDone:[{id,livingRefs,receiptRef/hash}],excludedWithdrawn:[{id,titleMarker,reason}],allocationNextId,manifestHash}. Canonical sorting/hash; all fields derived from one locked immutable source snapshot, not caller prose. Manifest is canonically derived, not a producer count: included ids union excludedDone/withdrawn must equal all graph ids, pairwise disjoint, and each included entry must resolve its complete required source/authority closure.
snapshotContract.predicate: DONE always excluded. Withdrawal only status BLOCKED with exact bracketed prefix [WITHDRAWN ...] matching trusted title; all other unfinished statuses included, including non-withdrawn BLOCKED. Unknown/malformed withdrawal status/title combinations fail WITHDRAWAL_AMBIGUOUS. Reject references to excluded withdrawn dependencies. Included-id union excluded sets equals entire snapshot task id set, disjoint and unique.
snapshotContract.freeze: Selected adapter GithubMainFreeze in main-freeze.mjs: operator-owned GitHub token locks main through branch protection lock_branch=true/enforce_admins=true, with force/deletion/bypass disabled and existing protection retained. If repository policy cannot enforce lock or credentials lack permission, fail before capture. GET confirms locked protection and exact main SHA; service appends freeze receipt {repo,mainSha,protectionDigest,nonce,held,authorityRevision}. Drain/reconcile legacy claims and provider callbacks before capturing closure. Lock remains until postcommit verification or explicit abort restores saved protection. No SQLite transaction is claimed to lock Git; remote lock observation and operator ownership are explicit prerequisites.
snapshotContract.storage: Fetch exact Git objects and refs before freeze; resolve via git show SHA:path and actual blob modes, never current checkout files. Evidence/log/receipt closure hashes checked; required external blobs must be retained and readable. Research baseline count is only a historical calibration fixture. Worker enumerates a fresh locked snapshot at execution.

transformContract.spec: Strict generation1 Work uses the delivered BB-155 resource schema, including resourceVersion1, inline objective/plan semantic hashes, preserved id/dependencies/components/scopes/labels and exact snapshot provenance. Status holds activeAttemptRef/activeLeaseRef/candidateVersionRef/evidenceVersionRef/readinessDecisionRef/latestCandidateDecisionRef/repairReflectionRef/deliveryReceiptRef only as applicable; no mutable arrays in Attempt. ResolveImportedAuthority accepts migration-role LegacyImportReceipt as a typed bridge for original independent readiness/candidate receipts; it cannot overwrite their original answers/stateHash/cacheKey. No legacy pathname becomes current authority.
phaseMap: RESEARCH_SA/RESEARCH -> RESEARCHING, no READY condition; may research ahead of dependencies
RESEARCH_SA/JUDGMENT -> PLAN_JUDGMENT only exact current plan/subject proof; otherwise abort
WORKER/EXECUTION -> READY with validated imported readiness, dependencies expressed as blockers; old unused candidate pointers carry no candidate judgment authority
WORKER/JUDGMENT -> JUDGING with exact imported subject/evidence and current independently bound pending decision; require no in-flight callback at freeze
WORKER/MERGE_PENDING -> MERGE_PENDING with original allSAT independent candidate Decision and exact candidate/evidence/tree identity; next VERIFY_MERGE, not execution
WORKER/REPAIR -> REPAIRING only when delivered controller supports exact legacy current repair authority including BB-157 reflection; otherwise parity blocker
Non-withdrawn BLOCKED -> BLOCKED preserving explicit blockers/no automatic claim
DONE/withdrawn -> no Work; active claim status -> drain/precondition failure, never fabricate lease
transformContract.importReceipt: LegacyImportReceipt {workId,newGeneration:1,legacySnapshotSha,legacyTaskHash,objectiveHash,planSemanticHash,originalReadinessRef/hash,originalCandidateEvaluationRef/hash?,originalEvidenceRef/hash?,validatorControllerDigest,verifiedBindings,importAttemptRef?,phaseMap,parityReportHash}. Trusted migration role stores it once; actors cannot publish it. V2 reads resolved immutable import receipts directly without scanning old graph. It maps existing valid semantic authority and never marks failed/unvalidated claims SATISFIED.
transformContract.terminalDependencies: Keep original dependency workId/requires in the edge. For a DONE source, source=LIVING and binding names exact delivered consolidated refs/hash and validated receipt/backup authority. No DONE row or full DONE-task copy in V2. V2 evaluates direct dependencies from Work delivery or trusted external Living facts supplied to pure next/context. Missing Living proof blocks import, not synthetic DONE creation.
transformContract.staleArtifacts: EXECUTION phase unused candidate/evidence artifacts are classified non-authoritative diagnostics, with exact hashes retained if referenced. Required current readiness/candidate/Decision/reflection must validate; otherwise whole migration aborts. No phase downgrade, receipt rewriting or old generation reconstruction.

parityContract.legacyOracle: Build legacy facts from task status/lane/phase and delivered taskReadiness/deriveDeliveryContext plus trusted receipt validators at the exact snapshot. PLANNED research without claim -> CLAIM_RESEARCH/START_RESEARCH, ACTIVE research -> PUBLISH_PLAN but capture rejects live ACTIVE. Unclaimed WORKER/EXECUTION -> CLAIM_EXECUTION with validated readiness/deps; MERGE_PENDING -> VERIFY_MERGE with exact accepted candidate; BLOCKED -> no writable action plus blockers. JUDGMENT/REPAIR requires fully validated phase-specific authority; unknown or unsettled ownership/receipt is a parity blocker, never invented lease/Decision/reflection. Normalize action names to the same semantic class but preserve authority, required inputs and source scope. No unconditional RESEARCH -> PUBLISH_PLAN shortcut.
parityContract.v2Oracle: Use delivered controller nextActions(snapshot) with resolved Work/Decision/import/dependency facts; no copied boolean substitutes for its lifecycle result. Compare full action id/class/preconditions, dependency blockers, semantic hashes, scopes and applicable receipt subject hashes for EVERY included id. Report exact mismatches, no sampling or count-only parity.
parityContract.outputs: Canonical ALL_WORK_PARITY_REPORT {manifestHash,controllerDigest,perWork:[{id,legacy,v2,equal,issues}],mismatchCount,checkedIdSetHash,reportHash}. Require mismatchCount0 and checked id set exactly manifest; validator runs before import visibility. Typed import receipt refers to this report.
parityContract.supervision: When BB-157 is enabled, compare LOOKBACK/REPAIRING and material-progress guard subjects/required output. A legacy unreflected repair cannot be silently upgraded/downgraded into legal V2 authority; it fails parity until legitimately resolved. Recommended operation is 155 DELIVERED ->157 DELIVERED ->fresh156snapshot/cutover.

cutoverContract.prepare: Ship service-aware trusted controller/CLI/bootstrap/CI release and bounded historical migration reader first, while selector remains LEGACY. Validate new release can operate under both pre/post selector states without dual-writing Work. Enable minProtocol gate, acquire main write lock, drain current operations, take snapshot, validate complete manifest/authority/parity and stage no visible Work.
cutoverContract.commit: BEGIN IMMEDIATE: CAS authority revision, currentWorkAuthority=LEGACY and authorityMode=ISOLATED_NEW_WORK; verify schema/controller/capabilities, held GithubMainFreeze receipt+locked main SHA, destination set hash and exact manifest/parity hash. Insert ALL Work/import authority/required immutable version records, canonical cutover receipt and BB-n allocator. Same COMMIT sets currentWorkAuthority=V2 and authorityMode=ALL_WORK and increments authorityRevision. Preserve pre-existing isolated V2 Work. Any exception rolls back every row/selector/allocation; no per-item visibility. Lost response resolves identical receipt/manifest before retry; conflicting receipt aborts.
cutoverContract.post: Read service selector+receipt and all manifest Work ids; compare full set/hashes/next/context and reject every legacy write/current-work reader. Mark source routing docs/deprecated graph pointer non-authoritative in prepared cleanup; retained receipt blobs remain immutable external subjects. Only then release repository freeze. If response was lost, immutable receipt id+manifestHash identifies successful cutover; conflict/missing receipt is fatal. Postcommit failure never switches back or dual-writes.

Current verify/CI validates service Work/selector and routing; historical validator helpers require explicit snapshot.
